A '''twister knife''' was a weapon that had three blades which spun in order to give the impression that they glittered like gems. The [[Blood Carver]] [[Ke Daiv]] attempted to kill [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with one in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].
